body:
DEMOLITION PASS ON THE STRAW MAN — retain the three-axis diagnosis and S5 court; revise S2, S3, S4, S6, S7, and I3 before this can become a plan.

WHAT I ACCEPT

- A1 structural validity, A2 plan admissibility, and A3 construction authority are genuinely separate.
- The S5 non-Cartesian 2x2 is the strongest architecture court in the proposal.
- Bare RecallGraph remains a structural view; scientific population admission needs a separately derived binding.
- Fixed-view sensitivity precedes any lattice.
- EventRecall reproduction runs in parallel under external data custody.
- No broad Checked rename.

1. Q1 / S2: OVERLAPPING CLAIMS ARE NOT A CUT POLICY

Partition and a covering with explicit gaps describe segmentation geometry. OverlappingClaims describes a different annotation system. Putting all three in one CutPolicy says they are variants of one estimand and recreates the universal-idea-unit defect.

The plan should derive geometry mechanically from exact transcript intervals: orderedness, overlap, coverage, and explicit gaps. A separate declared policy says which typed exclusions are licensed for the scientific use: interviewer speech, redaction, filler, uninterpretable material, etc. Geometry is derivable; the meaning and admissibility of a gap are not.

Also, “comparable only under the same policy” is too strong. Policy equality is sufficient for some comparisons, not necessary. Sensitivity may intentionally compare two policies after a checked projection onto a common observation measure. Comparability must be a derived relation for a named estimand and crosswalk, never enum equality.

Court:
- partition grains use ordered disjoint intervals plus typed include/exclude or gap evidence;
- proposition, repair, hedge, discourse-act, and association spans remain a separate overlapping evidence structure;
- no overlapping annotation can enter a partition-plan constructor merely by selecting another enum case.

2. S3: THE SINGLE LICENCE AXIS STILL CONFLATES THE COORDINATES

Heuristic, ProviderResolved, Calibrated, and Adjudicated are not siblings on one axis. Construction route, resolver outcome, calibration basis, and adjudication basis vary independently. The proposal correctly rejects Calibrated | Adjudicated at the gate, but it has already asserted the same comparison by placing them in one Licence enum.

More sharply: producers must not mint authority. Producers mint proposals and receipts. The resolver/checker mints the joined construction witness.

The decoder rule needs two corrections:

- “where it cannot re-derive authority, mint Heuristic” is a fabricated default license. Unknown provenance is not evidence that the heuristic produced the graph. Decode structurally only, mark provenance unverified in an outer artifact, or refuse the scientific artifact.
- Recomputing a checksum proves internal integrity, not external authenticity. A caller can forge provider/adjudicator labels and recompute an ordinary digest. Provider or adjudication authority requires deterministic replay against admitted ledgers plus a trusted registry/keyed authority/signature, or it remains unverified. embed-core’s keyed receipt snapshot and trusted-receipt normalization are an existing pattern; a plain content hash alone is not an authenticity proof.

The bare RecallGraph codec may keep minting structural Checked. It must never mint scientific authority. A full-artifact decoder may mint the witness only after replay/revalidation under the required trust roots.

3. Q5 / S4: REUSE THE ENVELOPE, NOT EXACT-VALUE RESOLUTION WHOLESALE

Q5 is fatal to “reuse wholesale.” Gaps 412 and 413 are distinct exact cuts; silently clustering them as equal launders a one-token difference that may move a predicate or cue. But treating them as wholly unrelated throws away genuine near-agreement.

Keep exact token-gap proposals distinct. A boundary-specific resolver may use a declared neighbourhood only to establish evidence for a boundary region. If evidence licenses the region but not the exact gap, retain exact locations as Alternatives or Unresolved; do not choose one because the build needs a graph. Calibration must be over the exact decision or explicitly over the region.

Boundary cannot enter the current generic family until D2 separates story hierarchy from recall segmentation and this agreement law is specified.

Two other corrections:
- the internal IllegalStateException after the deterministic producer makes structurally inconsistent parts remains an invariant breach; ordinary absence/conflict moves to typed outcomes;
- do not require “at least one Unresolved on a real transcript.” That rewards manufactured abstention. Use an admitted or synthetic ambiguous case where evidence is deliberately insufficient, plus an unambiguous positive control.

4. Q3 / S6: TOP-K IS NOT YET MARGINALIZATION

If path values are raw scores or proposal frequencies, S6 returns a labeled family of complete analyses. It does not have p(pi | X), a top-K posterior, or a licensed weighted marginal. Once path probabilities are calibrated, any truncation must receipt K, captured mass, tail mass or bound, renormalization, pruning, providers, and calibration identity.

Source-node labels are common coordinates, but not by themselves a common measure. Source visitation, transition flow, external mass, compression, and chronology still need declared denominators/base mass.

For Q3, do not force one answer. Candidate scientific views include:
- transcript-measure estimands projected onto exact token/time spans;
- claim-measure estimands projected onto span-backed resolved propositions;
- conditional families when the claim coordinate itself changes and no honest crosswalk exists.

Recall chronology can be common only if it is defined over stable transcript-position or claim-evidence coordinates, not unit ordinals. Compression can be common only after “content mass” is named and derived. If two valid measures answer different questions, publish two coordinates; do not wrap them into one Level.

5. S7: FACTOR THE COURT AND USE COMMON ENDPOINTS

H2 currently says “content-changing merge,” which changes segmentation and interpretation together. Split the court:

A. same resolved content plus content-preserving cut change -> named non-segmentation estimand stays within delta;
B. same cut plus role/polarity/context/omission change -> the corresponding estimand moves in the predicted direction beyond Delta;
C. boundary change makes an interpretation incompatible -> joint resolver explicitly rejects, retains, or re-resolves, and the downstream change is attributed to that joined decision.

H3 must use predeclared common tasks. EventRecall does not emit calibrated omission, intrusion, chronology, or conclusion-change decisions, so our method cannot “beat” it on those until a baseline decision rule and independent labels are defined. Use:
- common gist endpoint under matched inputs/providers/budget;
- additional independently labeled error endpoints with explicit baseline rules;
- uncertainty-specific decision value versus MAP-only ablation.

Passing these on one dataset licenses the next experiment, not the lattice automatically. The lattice needs replication/provider shift plus sparse-complexity value over fixed-view sensitivity. Conversely, failure of one scalar gist coefficient does not prove all richer outputs are ceremony if independently validated decision value exists.

6. I3: REJECT TRANSCRIPT-PLUS-SPAN AS RecallUnitId

The same exact span can be:
- a partition unit at one grain;
- a memory claim at another grain;
- the same unit under two construction policies;
- two competing interpretations.

Hashing only transcript identity plus span makes those distinct objects identical. It also turns the crosswalk into an asserted identity instead of a derived relation.

Give exact transcript spans/candidate gaps stable evidence identities. Keep the resolved unit identity artifact-local, or derive it from construction-artifact identity plus grain and exact span support. Cross-alternative correspondence is then a checked span/claim crosswalk, not RecallUnitId equality. The golden-fixture cost is secondary; the semantic conflation is decisive.

7. SEQUENCING

S1 is valid independent type hygiene and can land separately, but it is not proof of the scientific authority design. S2 and S3 must be designed together because plan identity, gap policy, and authority are joined at serialization. Their courts can have both cells immediately through deterministic fake proposals and the real resolver; no heuristic grandfathering is needed. Scientific population capability may honestly remain unavailable until a real resolved producer exists, while diagnostic output stays explicitly baseline-conditioned.

The straw man is close enough to refine, but not ready for chief adoption. My required changes are: partition geometry separate from overlapping interpretation; multi-coordinate authority derived by the resolver; fail-closed unverified decoding with an explicit trust model; boundary-specific near-agreement semantics; unweighted sensitivity before calibrated marginalization; factored empirical courts; and span evidence identity separate from resolved-unit identity.

No implementation, vocabulary, ADR, bead, path, reservation, data import, or SOTA claim is made.
